directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write a letter to express your thanks to one of your school teachers upon entering college. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Dear [Teacher's Name],

I hope this letter finds you in good health and high spirits. As I've settled into college, I've been reflecting on the profound impact you had on my academic journey, and I feel compelled to express my heartfelt gratitude.

To begin with, your teaching methods were truly inspiring. You had a unique way of making complex concepts easy to understand. For instance, in your math class, you used real-life examples to explain difficult formulas, which not only helped me grasp the knowledge but also made learning enjoyable. 

In addition, your encouragement and support were invaluable. Whenever I faced challenges or setbacks, you were always there to offer words of wisdom and motivation. Your belief in me gave me the confidence to overcome difficulties and strive for better results. 

Furthermore, you taught me important life lessons beyond the textbooks. You emphasized the importance of integrity, perseverance, and self-discipline, which have become guiding principles in my life.

In conclusion, I am extremely grateful for your dedication and influence. You have not only shaped my academic success but also played a crucial role in my personal growth. I will always remember you and the positive impact you've had on me.

Yours sincerely,
[Your Name]
